reason: No model has reproducible promotion evidence: the live transcription comparison uses a mutable alias and the runtime price catalog lacks an exact immutable snapshot price.
resumeConditions: new live comparison records an immutable model snapshot
the exact snapshot is present in the versioned runtime price catalog
explicit production authorization before any Render change
pre-change smoke plus recorded owner and window

rules: capture the exact Render configuration for the capability before any change and use it as the operational rollback snapshot
restore only the affected capability variables
keep fallback and cross-provider fallback disabled unless separately approved with evidence
run a sanitized capability smoke after restoration
pause instead of promoting when the resolved state is invalid or when the observed production baseline conflicts with the versioned baseline
